name: PPC Daily Plan Report
query:
SELECT
  dp.name AS `Plan:Link/PPC Daily Plan:160`,
  dp.planning_date AS `Date:Date:100`,
  dp.shift AS `Shift:Data:100`,
  dp.workstation AS `Workstation:Link/Workstation:160`,
  dp.status AS `Status:Data:100`,
  pi.sequence AS `Seq:Int:60`,
  pi.source_job_card AS `Job Card:Link/Job Card Computer Paper:160`,
  pi.customer AS `Customer:Data:160`,
  pi.stage AS `Stage:Data:140`,
  pi.planned_qty AS `Planned:Float:100`,
  pi.planned_uom AS `UOM:Data:80`,
  pi.remaining_balance AS `Balance:Float:100`,
  pi.line_status AS `Line Status:Data:140`,
  pi.priority AS `Priority:Data:100`,
  pi.due_date AS `Due:Date:100`
FROM `tabPPC Daily Plan` dp
LEFT JOIN `tabPPC Daily Plan Item` pi ON pi.parent = dp.name
WHERE dp.docstatus < 2
ORDER BY dp.planning_date DESC, dp.workstation ASC, dp.shift ASC, pi.sequence ASC
